text.p: Vitol Gas & Electric LLC said it is distrbuting 300 megawatts of power produced by Public Service Eletric & Gas Co under a 15 month coal tolling agreement.
Vitol G&E, which is 51 percent owned by Vitol SA, said it will supply 750,000 tons of coal under the agreement.

"We bring physical coal to the generating station, at economics that make sense, and then sell the electricity into the Pennsylvania-Jersey-Maryland Power Pool and the Northeast," said George McClellan, head of Vitol G&E's coal division.

The power being delivered to Vitol is half that being produced by the Public Service Enterprise Group Inc utility subsidiary under coal tolling arrangements. Another 300 megawatts is being produced for LG&E Energy Corp.
